summary: Frontend UI testing for User Management (Settings), Logout redirect, and datetime-local min attr on Pieces/Campaigns scheduling. 10/12 checks passed. Two issues found: (1) Logout redirects to /login instead of landing (/) due to a duplicate '/' Route in App.js causing ProtectedRoute to intercept the redirect. (2) Settings users table shows raw plan id (e.g., 'agency') instead of the friendly label (e.g., 'Enterprise').

ui_bugs.issue: Two <Route path="/"> declarations (Landing + ProtectedRoute layout). After logout, navigate('/') is intercepted by ProtectedRoute and redirects to /login. Handle by removing the duplicate parent path='/' on the protected AppLayout (use path='' with index children, or wrap children under a distinct base path). Expected: landing page visible after logout.
Displays raw plan id: {u.plan} => shows 'agency','pro','trial' instead of PLANS label 'Enterprise','Pro','Trial'. Also role column may show raw id. Apply PLAN_LABELS/ROLE_LABELS mapping.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (a11y warning in console).

action_items: Fix App.js: remove/rename duplicate '/' route so navigate('/') after logout renders <Landing/> (currently redirects to /login).
Settings.jsx: map plan/role ids to labels in the users table row for better UX.
Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) inside user-dialog to silence a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js has two routes with path='/', causing routing ambiguity — React Router will match the ProtectedRoute layout for '/' if the user is authenticated but redirects to /login when logout clears user state (observed behavior).
Settings.jsx renders raw enum values in the users table instead of localized labels.
DialogContent throughout Settings lacks DialogDescription for accessibility.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted temporary QA user qauser+<rand>@vanguarda.com.br via UI (cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tests executed via Playwright against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. PASS: login_admin, settings_tab_team_visible, users_table_visible, new_user_button_visible, create_user (dialog closes + row appears), edit_email_disabled (email field disabled in edit mode), admin_own_delete_disabled, delete_user (window.confirm accepted, row removed), piece_schedule_min (min=2026-09-17T11:30), campaign_schedule_min (min=2026-09-17T11:30). FAIL: logout_to_landing (url ends at /login, no [data-testid=landing-page]); edit_user_plan_enterprise (assertion looked for 'Enterprise' text in row but table renders raw plan id 'agency' — update likely persisted correctly, only display label wrong). No 500s in console.
rca_of_the_issue: Logout: App.js declares '/' twice. When handleLogout calls navigate('/'), the matched route is the ProtectedRoute-wrapped AppLayout (last matching '/' with children) which forces redirect to /login when user becomes null. Fix by consolidating routes — e.g., remove path='/' from the protected parent Route (use path-less parent and give children absolute paths like /dashboard) or reorder/simplify. Plan label: Settings.jsx table cell uses {u.plan} without label map.
